review: راضٍ وشاكر is שָׁלֵו וּמוֹדֶה throughout: שָׁלֵו (Job 21:23, Ps 73:12) is the biblical 'at ease, content' adjective, where רָצוּי would read 'acceptable' and not 'content'.
